newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's Riksbank sets repo at unchanged 4.10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's Riksbank sets repo at unchanged 4.10 pct.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, on Tuesday left its key interest rate, the repo rate, unchanged at 4.10 percent at its weekly tender.
A Reuters poll of 10 economists found no one had expected the Riksbank to lower the repo rate which is the bank's key tool for controlling money market liquidity.
The new reverse repurchase operation will run from March 19 to March 26.
The Riksbank last cut the repo rate on December 17.
Its other key interest rates, the deposit and lending rates, currently stand at 3.75 percent and 5.25 percent respectively.
